target.title: fix: harden docs map heading rendering
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves an edge case where generated docs navigation could treat heading markup inconsistently when source headings included literal HTML-like text.

## Why This Change Was Made

The docs map generator now escapes heading HTML characters before writing headings into Markdown instead of trying to strip tags. This keeps literal command placeholders visible while rendering embedded markup as text.

## User Impact

Docs readers and agents get a generated docs map that preserves heading text accurately and consistently. There is no runtime product behavior change.

AI-assisted: yes, implemented with Codex.

## Evidence

- `pnpm format:fix -- scripts/generate-docs-map.mjs test/scripts/generate-docs-map.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/generate-docs-map.test.ts`
- `pnpm docs:map:check`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local`
- Autoreview result: `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`
- `git diff --check`
